subject: MAP draft and SOC 2 package delivery — Aurelia Tech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aureliatech.com>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@aureliatech.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and SOC 2 package delivery — Aurelia Tech

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on your success criteria. Per our discussion, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an initial SOC 2 checklist that should help your security and procurement teams scope the review. Key items below and proposed dates.

Summary / next steps (quick):
- Redwood to deliver: MAP draft (attached), SOC 2 evidence index + Type II report copy, and sample config docs.
- Aurelia to: confirm security reviewer(s), share any additional questionnaire items, and confirm procurement timeline.
- Proposed security-review kickoff: Fri, 2026-06-26 at 10:00 PT (we can move if needed).

Draft MAP highlights (milestones, owner, target date, dependencies):
1) Security review kickoff — Owner: Aurelia (security) / Redwood (support) — Target: 2026-06-26 — Dependency: Aurelia to confirm reviewer list and preferred secure transfer method.
2) SOC 2 package delivery (report + evidence index) — Owner: Redwood (Neha) — Target: 2026-06-24 — Dependency: NDA or secure transfer agreed.
3) Legal/contract redlines — Owner: Aurelia legal / Redwood legal — Target: 2026-07-01 — Dependency: SOC 2 package delivered.
4) Procurement PO / Purchase Order — Owner: Aurelia procurement — Target: 2026-07-05 — Dependency: Contract agreed.
5) Pilot / Staging validation — Owner: Aurelia engineering — Target: 2026-07-15 — Dependency: Access & test data.
6) GA / Go-live — Owner: Both — Target: 2026-07-30 — Dependency: Pilot success + PO.

Attachment: 20260620-Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP table + responsibilities)
Also attached is a short SOC 2 checklist we referenced. I’ll follow up with a detailed evidence index (spreadsheet) by Tuesday.

Could you confirm: who from Aurelia will lead security review and whether you prefer SFTP, SharePoint, or another transfer method for artifacts? Once confirmed, we’ll route our SOC 2 materials to that channel.

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

--
Attachment: 20260620-Redwood-MAP-draft.pdf (1.2MB stub)
Attachment: SOC2-checklist.pdf (120KB stub)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aureliatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@aureliatech.com>, security@aureliatech.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and SOC 2 package delivery — Aurelia Tech

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A couple of clarifying questions from our security team before the kickoff:
1) Can you provide a full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) plus a control-mapping / evidence index (spreadsheet) that maps each control to artifacts we can review?
2) For evidence, we typically ask for sample configs, admin access logs (last 90 days), change management tickets, and third-party vendor attestations. Can you confirm what you will provide and what requires an NDA?
3) Procurement needs a clear target for PO submission — we're aiming to close procurement by 07/05, so any blocking legal / security items should be resolved by then.

Attaching our standard security questionnaire (Aurelia-Security-Questionnaire.pdf) — please review and flag anything that will require a redaction or NDA. Also please loop in your security/contact who will be responsible for the materials.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Head of IT Security | Aurelia Tech
daniel.park@aureliatech.com

--
Attachment: Aurelia-Security-Questionnaire.pdf (820KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aureliatech.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and SOC 2 package delivery — Aurelia Tech

Daniel — thanks for the questionnaire, and for the procurement timing note. Per internal sync with Neha and Dev (looped), we’ve prepared an evidence index and an updated MAP with explicit SOC 2 deliverables. Key commitments below and I’ve attached the evidence spreadsheet.

Redwood commitments (what we will provide):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) — PDF copy (deliver by 2026-06-24).
- Evidence index (spreadsheet listing artifacts per control) — deliver by 2026-06-24.
- Sample configuration documents (KMS integration, TLS cert rotation, key management controls) — deliver by 2026-06-24.
- Access logs / admin activity extracts (redacted where necessary) — sample 90-day window (deliver by 2026-06-24).
- Point of contact for technical walkthrough (Dev Patel) — available for review sessions.

Updated MAP (brief):
- Security review kickoff: 2026-06-26 10:00 PT — Owner: Aurelia security / Redwood (Neha) — Action: confirm SFTP or SharePoint.
- SOC2 package delivery (report + evidence index): 2026-06-24 — Owner: Redwood (Neha).
- Legal review complete: 2026-07-01 — Owner: Aurelia legal / Redwood legal.
- Procurement PO received: 2026-07-05 — Owner: Aurelia procurement.
- Pilot start: 2026-07-15 — Owner: Aurelia eng.

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (detailed mapping + sample filenames).

We recommend secure transfer via SFTP or your SharePoint; if there is an NDA requirement for raw logs, we can execute an NDA/DSA and redact PII as needed. Dev can lead the technical review during the kickoff.

Let us know if the 06/24 delivery and 06/26 kickoff timeline works. If procurement needs the PO earlier, we can prioritize the SOC2 handoff and build an exec summary for procurement to speed approval.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Attachment: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (24KB stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aureliatech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and SOC 2 package delivery — Aurelia Tech

Hi Daniel / team — Neha from Redwood security here. Quick clarifications and commitments from our side:
- We will provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and a control-to-evidence index (spreadsheet). The index will include sample artifact filenames and redaction notes where applicable.
- Evidence we can provide (examples): system architecture diagram, change management tickets (redacted), IAM policy exports, admin access logs (90 days, redacted), vulnerability scan summaries, vendor SOC attestations, config snippets for TLS/KMS, incident response runbook excerpt.
- Anything that contains customer PII or extremely sensitive data will be redacted; if Aurelia requires unredacted logs we request an NDA and controlled transfer.
- For transfer: we can SFTP to a customer-provided server, SharePoint link, or a secure AWS S3 pre-signed URL. We’ll include checksums for integrity.
- Secure notes: expect the SOC 2 PDF + index + sample artifacts in a secure bundle by 2026-06-24 EOD.

I’ve attached transfer instructions and a short checklist for your security reviewer. For the kickoff, please share the meeting invite and list of participants. Dev will be available for the technical walkthrough.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: instructions-secure-transfer.txt (1.5KB)

Subject: Re: MAP draft and SOC 2 package delivery — Aurelia Tech

Thanks Marissa and Neha — that schedule works for us and the questionnaire looks fine. A few notes from procurement/security:
- Procurement expects to issue the PO by 2026-07-05. Please add a MAP milestone for Procurement sign-off (target 2026-07-06) so we have a clear acceptance window.
- We accept SFTP or SharePoint for the secure bundle; we will send a SharePoint link before the 06/26 kickoff.
- For the kickoff on 06/26 at 10:00 PT, attendees will be: Daniel Park (security), Sarah Jones (procurement), and one engineer (TBD). Please confirm Neha and Dev will join.

Action items we’ll take:
- Aurelia to review SOC 2 package and mark items requiring NDA/redaction by 2026-06-29.
- Procurement to circulate PO draft by 2026-07-02.

We’ll plan for the procurement sign-off milestone on 2026-07-06 as requested. See you on the 26th.

Regards,
Daniel
